R(3,3): the least positive integer n such that every red-blue coloring of the edges of the complete graph on n vertices contains a triangle whose three edges have one color
v: an arbitrary vertex in the complete graph on six vertices
x, y, z: three distinct vertices joined to v by edges of one common color
c: one of three distinct neighbors of v joined to v by edges of one common color
a: one of three distinct neighbors of v joined to v by edges of one common color
b: one of three distinct neighbors of v joined to v by edges of one common color
C: the common color of the three selected edges incident to v
i: An arbitrary vertex label in the five-vertex lower-bound construction; labels are interpreted modulo 5.
j: a second vertex label distinct from i in the explicit five-vertex construction
n: the number of vertices appearing in the definition of R(3,3)
\\gamma: one of the two colors, chosen to occur on at least three edges incident with v
x: one of three distinct vertices joined to v by an edge of color gamma
y: a second of three distinct vertices joined to v by an edge of color gamma
z: a third of three distinct vertices joined to v by an edge of color gamma
